g.text: Composition root (app.New, upgrade seam to system/v5)
Identity bounded context (internal/identity, extracted from web)
Serve composition module (extracted boot wiring: sources, identity, middlewares)
Web UI packages (internal/web split by concern)
Owner-gated ASR enrichment variant (never overwrites source transcript)
one-shot ingest verbs (cdr, telnyx, webhook, agent)
read package (queries, keyset walk, representative collapse, read-time join)
recording proxy package (Telnyx signed URL, local WAV)
page chrome package (layout, nav, palette, shared templ)
enforced PII policy (E164 + ParticipantHash in reads and exports)
planned analytics (MOS trend per DID, AI-vs-human cost split, source-mix segments)
